qa_pairs.question: How do you start an Abaqus graphical session using JupyterLab on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: To start an Abaqus graphical session via JupyterLab, first, initiate a JupyterHub desktop session using one of the provided links, such as FIR, NARVAL, or RORQUAL. Next, in the left-hand side 'Available Module' section, highlight an Abaqus module (e.g., `abaqus/2026`) and click 'Load'. An 'Abaqus (VNC)' icon will then appear on your desktop, which you can click to automatically launch Abaqus in a remote Jupyter desktop.

qa_pairs.question: What are the specific JupyterHub links available for starting an Abaqus session on Alliance clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: You can start a JupyterHub desktop session for Abaqus on Alliance clusters using these links: FIR at `https://jupyterhub.fir.alliancecan.ca`, NARVAL at `https://portail.narval.calculquebec.ca/`, or RORQUAL at `https://jupyterhub.rorqual.alliancecan.ca`.

qa_pairs.question: After starting a JupyterHub desktop session, what is the next step to launch Abaqus?
qa_pairs.answer: After starting a JupyterHub desktop session, you need to highlight an Abaqus module, such as `abaqus/2026`, in the left-hand side 'Available Module' section. Once highlighted, click on 'Load' to make an 'Abaqus (VNC)' icon appear on the desktop, which you can then click to launch the application.
